effectSummary.ko: 8초간 최대 HP 25% 보호막을 얻고 일반 액티브 피해 +20%, 비용 감소 +20%p를 얻습니다. 이 시간에 서로 다른 세 원소의 일반 액티브를 시전하면 마지막 기술의 첫 적중 위치에 반경 2.5m·최대 5명에게 원소별 D40% 추가 폭발이 일어납니다. 순환 완성당 1회, 시전 전체 최대 2회입니다.
effectSummary.en: Gain a 25% maximum-HP barrier for 8s, +20% normal-active damage and +20 percentage points of normal-active cost reduction. Completing a three-element normal-active cast cycle triggers D40% per element within 2.5m, up to 5 targets, at the last skill's first impact. Once per completed cycle, at most twice per ultimate.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: HELLSCRIPT Mage skill icon, M18 Sage Incarnate / 현자의 화신, ultimate.
Primary request: Create ONE original independent 1024x1024 PNG icon with REAL NATIVE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. A majestic hooded sage bust transformed into a dense radiant spectral incarnation, faceless charcoal hood above broad angular shoulders of luminous ice-blue barrier. Three substantial elemental flares, ember, frost and lightning, rise from the shoulders and crown in an integrated silhouette. Ultimate power through strong centered mass and transformation, no halo circle, frame or portrait panel.
Effect context: Gain a 25% maximum-HP barrier for 8s, +20% normal-active damage and +20 percentage points of normal-active cost reduction. Completing a three-element normal-active cast cycle triggers D40% per element within 2.5m, up to 5 targets, at the last skill's first impact. Once per completed cycle, at most twice per ultimate.
Relevant equipment linkage: DES_LM46. Match the effect rather than copying existing item art.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy game art, sculptural large shapes, restrained tactile brush texture, somber charcoal shadows, weathered materials where relevant, pale high-contrast edges, selective saturated magic. Two or three major forms, minimal tiny particles. Legible and individually recognizable at 64px.
Composition: centered cohesive isolated subject, every visible shape and glow fully inside the central 76 percent of the square canvas; at least 12 percent completely transparent padding on all four sides. Only the depicted skill, no surrounding scene.
Output: exactly 1024x1024 PNG with native RGBA alpha. All surrounding and internal empty space truly transparent. Preserve clean antialiased alpha edges, no opaque matte or halo.
Avoid: any background or solid backdrop, checkerboard picture, floor, ground, cast shadow, stand, UI panel, frame, border, lettering, written runes, digits, ID labels, logo or watermark. Do not copy or recolor an existing icon.

readability64.ko: 넓은 어깨와 후드, 세 원소의 불꽃이 현자의 강화 형상을 드러냅니다.
readability64.en: Broad shoulders, a hood and three elemental flares identify an empowered sage incarnation.

edges.ko: 원본과 밝은·어두운 바탕의 256px 검수에서 불투명 매트, 배경 무늬, 잘린 주형태를 발견하지 못했습니다. 가장자리의 매우 낮은 알파 픽셀은 자동 경고로 남깁니다.
edges.en: Native output and 256px light/dark inspection showed no opaque matte, backdrop pattern or clipped main form. Very low-alpha border pixels remain recorded warnings.

distinctness.en: The major silhouette and effect remain distinct among this production group in the actual64px contact sheets.
